# update_agent_tool

> Update an existing LLM agent by name.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=update_agent_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Update an existing LLM agent by name. This tool allows you to modify agent configuration
including dual prompts (system/user), tools, resources, role assignments, and settings.

RECOMMENDED WORKFLOW:
1. Use list_available_agents_tool to find the agent you want to update
2. Use list_available_llm_models_tool if you need to change the model
3. Use list_available_prompts_tool with availability_type="agent" to find prompts (system/user)
4. Use general_crud_tool with model_name="RoleType" to find available roles
5. Use this update_agent_tool with the agent name and updates

REQUIRED FIELDS:
- agent_name: The name of the agent to update (must exist)
- updates: Object containing the fields to update

NEW FEATURES:
- **Dual-Prompt System**: Agents now support separate system and user prompts
- **Role Management**: Agents can be assigned roles through the roles array
- **Enhanced Control**: System prompts define personality, user prompts define tasks

UPDATABLE FIELDS:
- description: Agent description
- schedule: Cron schedule or null (changing it recomputes next_run_at immediately; null clears it)
- active: Boolean to enable/disable agent
- tool_configurations: Object with tool configurations
- internal_tool_use_list: Array of system tool names
- internal_resource_use_list: Array of system resource names
- discoverable_by_other_agents: Boolean for agent discovery
- llm_model: Object with internal_identifier to change model
- llm_system_prompt: System prompt text (defines agent personality/behavior)
- llm_user_prompt: User prompt text (defines specific tasks)
- roles: Array of role internal_identifiers to assign to agent
- llm_tools: Array of custom tools (will replace existing)
- llm_resources: Array of custom resources (will replace existing)

EXAMPLE:
{
  "agent_name": "my_agent",
  "updates": {
    "description": "Updated AI Assistant",
    "active": true,
    "llm_model": {
      "internal_identifier": "gpt-4"
    },
    "llm_system_prompt": "You are an expert software engineer with deep knowledge of best practices.",
    "llm_user_prompt": "Help the user write clean, efficient code with proper documentation.",
    "roles": ["software_engineer", "code_reviewer"],
    "internal_tool_use_list": ["general_crud_tool", "send_email_tool"]
  }
}

NOTE:
- You cannot change the agent name itself
- Omitted fields will not be changed
- To clear arrays, pass empty arrays []
- llm_tools and llm_resources arrays will completely replace existing ones
- roles array will replace all existing role assignments
- Both system and user prompts are updated as text strings now

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_name` | string | yes | The name of the agent to update. |
| `updates` | object | yes | Object containing the fields to update. |
